description: This file defines TypeScript types and functions related to auto-reply payloads and context in a chat or webchat system, including reply options, reply payload structure, context for reply handling, and metadata management.

methods.name: setReplyPayloadMetadata
methods.description: Associates metadata with a reply payload object, merging with existing metadata if present.

methods.name: getReplyPayloadMetadata
methods.description: Retrieves metadata associated with a reply payload object.
